what_happened: A scratchpad prototype fixture named *-state.json that mentioned active_projects was refused by the state-write backstop hook (command-text scan); the prototype was restructured to read the consumer state read-only and keep only the new milestone keys in a separate overlay file, so no state-shaped file is written anywhere.

suite_selection_select returns a mixed sentinel-plus-30-to-76-suite set for any phase touching manifest.json, agent/command markdown, or widely referenced script headers, so a below-full Tier Justification naming the real suites is impractical; four non-final phases (2, 5, 7, 8) were declared full with a named cross-cutting surface instead.

Ordering the lint retarget before the renderer change, and adding the milestone render path beside the classic one before deleting it, gave every phase a green boundary without a multi-suite atomic batch; found by reading that test-orchestrate-conclusion-roadmap.sh copies the real renderer over classic fixtures.

verify-touched.sh with explicit source-store paths resolves the right suites but runs them from the stale deployed tree (.claude/scripts/tests), so it does not exercise un-deployed source edits; each phase re-runs the selected suites through the source-store run-all.sh --only as the real check.
